g.text: The single input boundary and term-id routing — no delimited key is ever live
field 0 is SPACE-separated: the quick brown
collision-safe: a token cannot contain the corpus's own space
LEB128 is self-terminating ⟹ NO delimiter byte
Route by the FIRST TOKEN's characters
never a term-id VALUE (unstable across vocabularies)
distinct byte keys ⟹ independent counts, no cross-talk
are NOT reinterpreted. There is no live converter — such shards
must be re-imported from source (see the design note §5).
